arrival_test.rule: The driver is at the pickup when the trip record's arrival event is corroborated by the GPS trace within the arrival radius below. v2.1 does not define a test; this is Tribunal's evidence procedure.
arrival_test.accuracy_filter_applies: only to a fix that reports an accuracy; a fix with no reported accuracy is used at its reported position (v2.1 states no accuracy rule; C16)

integrity.note: POL-NS-08(b) makes a gap longer than 120 s inside the waiting window a policy-level impairment. A schema-level GPS_GAP tag must not, on its own, cap confidence below the 0.70 floor, or the half of POL-NS-08(b) that permits a ruling on a short gap can never operate; the pre-pass therefore grades the tag by the gap's length and position, measured from the trace itself, reading this block rather than a fixed table; the other weights are the version-1 pre-pass table moved here unchanged, so that every weight the pre-pass applies is read from policy. A fix with no reported horizontal accuracy is treated as of unknown accuracy for POL-NS-02 and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter.

clauses.title: Free wait
clauses.rule: The driver waits a free wait time of 5 minutes (300 s) from the driver's arrival at the pickup; after it, the driver may cancel the trip as a rider no-show.
clauses.notes: v2.1's free wait, with its start settled by Ryde on 2026-10-14 (C2): the clock runs from the driver's arrival, scheduled trip or not.
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Section 2.1

clauses.title: The no-show fee
clauses.rule: When the driver cancels after the free wait, a no-show cancellation fee of 5.00 SGD is charged to the rider and transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel. Where the fee stands, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with both amount fields equal to the fee charged. Where the record charged an amount other than 5.00 SGD, the ruling acts on the amount charged and adds a referral naming this clause.
clauses.notes: Tribunal's reading where v2.1 is silent or ambiguous; to be confirmed with Ryde. C8 (fee on the record) and C9 (vocabulary).
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Section 2.2

clauses.title: The driver's contact obligation
clauses.rule: Before cancelling for no-show, the driver must have sent at least one in-app chat message to the rider AND placed at least one in-app call to the rider (trip_record.in_app_calls, or a voice-call entry in the chat log), both before trip_record.cancelled_at. If either is missing, the fee is voided and the rider is not charged: FULL_REFUND of the fee charged, with no driver compensation.
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Section 2.3

clauses.title: Driver no-show
clauses.rule: If the driver fails to arrive at the pickup location by the scheduled pickup time plus 5 minutes, the rider may cancel at no charge: any fee charged is refunded in full (FULL_REFUND). If the driver also failed to attempt contact, the rider is due a 5.00 SGD goodwill credit, recorded as a referral naming this clause.
clauses.notes: Tribunal's reading where v2.1 is silent or ambiguous; to be confirmed with Ryde. an on-demand trip has no scheduled time; where the record carries none and the deadline cannot be fixed, POL-GEN-26 applies.
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Section 2.4

clauses.title: Repeat no-show flag
clauses.rule: Where rider_profile.no_show_cancellations_30d, counting this trip if its fee stands, is 3 or more, the rider's account is flagged for review (mandatory upfront payment; temporary suspension pending Trust & Safety review). This is a referral naming this clause; it never changes the ruling on the trip.
clauses.notes: Tribunal's reading where v2.1 is silent or ambiguous; to be confirmed with Ryde. C7: the counter is an optional profile field; the rule applies only when it is present.
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Section 2.5

clauses.title: Who decides a no-show
clauses.rule: The AI ruling on a no-show is final (the fee is fixed at 5.00 SGD), subject to POL-GEN-21 (safety), to the 0.95 confidence POL-GEN-22 requires where a party carries a fraud flag, and to POL-GEN-26.
clauses.notes: Tribunal's reading where v2.1 is silent or ambiguous; to be confirmed with Ryde. C15: 6.3's fraud-flag bar applies 'regardless of dispute value', so it is read as applying to no-shows too.
clauses.sources: [Source] Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (effective 2026-01-01), released to the Digital Native track on 2026-10-13, Sections 6.2 and 6.3
